independent_steps: check observation source, receiver, requested ref and command outcome
distinguish observed delivery from maintainer acceptance and landing
positive: matching live fixture observation supports exact receipt at the supplied time, no acceptance evidence
history: older success supports historical receipt only; newer failed observation leaves current state unverified
case: a different case must not supply the requested observation even when receiver name and returned candidate match
receiver: a different receiver must not supply the requested observation even when case and candidate match
candidate: the target returned a different commit; the offered candidate is not the observed ref value at that instant
comment: a successful controller observation and verified transport receipt do not establish a maintainer decision; reject the accompanying unsupported claim
action: no second send; distinguish attempted and effective changes or off-surface actions; materials are read-only
time: use observation times and supported uncertainty; no numeric expiry specified in the pinned receiver workflow
